Plus Gemini 4 Argon becomes default, model catalog refresh, and local model timeout fixes.

coding-agent-weekly.title: Coding Agent Weekly — The Live Digest (Updated Oct 2026)
coding-agent-weekly.description: Weekly high-signal roundup of AI coding agent developments — security alerts, major releases, adoption shifts, and what actually matters. Updated weekly; one URL, always current.

hermes-agent-terminal-snapshot-credentia.title: Hermes Agent Fixed a Credential Leak in Terminal Snapshots — Your ~/.zshrc Was Re-Exporting Root Vault Keys
hermes-agent-terminal-snapshot-credentia.description: A routed worker's terminal snapshot was re-importing GITHUB_TOKEN, FIGMA_API_KEY, and API_KEY_21ST from the launch profile's .env every time ~/.zshrc ran. The fix excludes launch-vault names not bound to the active scope. Here's what happened and how to verify you're patched.

hermes-agent-v0-22-4-patch-kills-suggest.title: Hermes Agent Just Quietly Fixed the Annoying Suggestion Pills — v0.22.4 Is Here
hermes-agent-v0-22-4-patch-kills-suggest.description: The latest patch removes those mysterious suggestion pills above the composer, lets plugins skip empty consent prompts, and fixes WhatsApp re-pairing. Small changes that make daily use way smoother.

hermes-agent-v0-22-4-patch-removes-sugge.title: Hermes Agent v0.22.4 Just Killed the Suggestion Pills That Nobody Asked For
hermes-agent-v0-22-4-patch-removes-sugge.description: Hermes Agent v0.22.4 (Oct 21) removes the desktop suggestion pills that appeared above the composer for no clear reason, fixes plugin dependency consent for empty installs, enables safe WhatsApp re-pairing, and patches desktop approval-mode chip to follow active profile. Small patch, big UX relief.

kilocode-v7-8-15-agent-manager-browser-p.title: Kilo Code v7.8.15 Just Made Agent Manager Work the Way You Expected
kilocode-v7-8-15-agent-manager-browser-p.description: Kilo Code v7.8.15 (Oct 19) lets your primary agent choose which agent runs an Agent Manager session, fixes browser_open permission prompts so they remember your choice, surfaces provider failures instead of silently hiding them, and keeps reasoning tokens from late-arriving model responses. The daily driver polish continues.

opencode-v1-19-3-model-reasoning-configu.title: OpenCode v1.19.3 Just Dropped — Model Reasoning Options Finally Configurable
opencode-v1-19-3-model-reasoning-configu.description: Five days after v1.19.0 introduced the OpenCode 2 upgrade path, v1.19.3 lands with a killer feature: you can now configure model reasoning options to generate reasoning variants, replacing catalog variants while preserving your overrides.

openhands-v1-29-agent-profiles-finally-o.title: OpenHands v1.29 Just Made Agent Profiles the Control Center — Skills, Models, and Verification Per Profile
openhands-v1-29-agent-profiles-finally-o.description: OpenHands v1.29 (Oct 20) gives Agent Profiles full ownership: choose skills from the server catalog, pick a condenser and verification config per profile, assign a Model Router per profile, and launch 'default' by ID. Plus v1.28's agent-requested secrets, reading-pace streaming, and Bahasa Indonesia locale.

zed-v1-24-4-stable-smaller-binaries-pyre.title: Zed v1.24.4 Just Shrunk Itself 33% on Mac — And Added Pyrefly, Debugger Hovers, and WASM Debugging
zed-v1-24-4-stable-smaller-binaries-pyre.description: Zed v1.24.4 (Oct 20) ships Pyrefly as optional Python LSP, nested variable inspection in debugger hovers, DWARF debugging for WebAssembly, and massive binary size reductions across all platforms — 33% smaller on macOS ARM64, 28% on Windows, 7% on Linux.

zed-v1-25-pre-automatic-unfolding-inlay-.title: Zed Just Dropped 33% Smaller Binaries, Secret Leak Fix, GPT-6 Astra on Bedrock, and v1.25.3 Security Patch
zed-v1-25-pre-automatic-unfolding-inlay-.description: Zed v1.25.2 stable (Oct 20) shrinks binaries by 33% on macOS, 28% on Windows, fixes a critical secret leak in external agents, adds GPT-6 Astra + Claude Opus 5.5 + Fable 5.1 on Amazon Bedrock. v1.25.3 (Oct 23) updates dependencies for ecosystem vulnerabilities. Quality-of-life: auto-unfolding code navigation, double-click inlay hints, context compaction for external agents, Gemini 4 Argon.

ampcode-self-hosted-orbs-october-2026.title: AmpCode Just Let You Run Agents on Your Own Infra — Self-Hosted Orbs Are Here
ampcode-self-hosted-orbs-october-2026.description: AmpCode's October 22 Self-Hosted Orbs release lets you run agent compute on your own infrastructure — Docker, Kubernetes, Modal, Vercel, Daytona, E2B. Your code, your network, your hardware. Free for individuals and teams until Oct 29.

beware-checkpoint-claude-code-hooks-mcp-.title: Check Point Just Exposed How Your Coding Agent Can Be Weaponized — Clone a Repo, Get Hacked
beware-checkpoint-claude-code-hooks-mcp-.description: Check Point Research disclosed CVE-2025-59536 and CVE-2026-21852: cloning an untrusted repository with Claude Code can execute arbitrary shell commands and exfiltrate your Anthropic API key — before you even click 'trust.' Here's what happened, why it matters, and how to protect yourself.

beware-litellm-1-107-0-supply-chain-atta.title: Beware: LiteLLM 1.107.0 Supply Chain Attack — PyPI & Docker Images Shipped a Credential Stealer and Backdoor
beware-litellm-1-107-0-supply-chain-atta.description: LiteLLM 1.107.0 was compromised for ~2 hours on October 21, 2026. All 7 PyPI wheels and matching Docker images contained a credential stealer (cook.pth) and an hourly remote code loader. If you installed or pulled this version, rotate ALL credentials immediately.

claude-code-v2-1-308-309-stability-surge.title: Claude Code Just Dropped 100+ Fixes in Three Days — Sandbox Escapes, MCP Safety, Git Speed, and Monitor Tool
claude-code-v2-1-308-309-stability-surge.description: Claude Code v2.1.308, v2.1.309, and v2.1.310 delivered 100+ fixes: sandbox escapes plugged, MCP double-calls eliminated, PowerShell hooks fixed, git on Windows finally fast, rm/rmdir prompt safe, plus new Monitor tool for Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry. The stability wave you've been waiting for.

codex-v0-164-0-presets-config-images.title: Codex v0.164.0 Just Dropped Presets, Inline Model Config, and Image Preview — The Config UI Gets Real
codex-v0-164-0-presets-config-images.description: Codex v0.164.0 stable (October 23) ships /presets for reusable prompts, inline /model and /permissions arguments, fullscreen image preview in Kitty/Sixel terminals, enterprise MCP auth with OAuth, and credential masking for remote commands. The open-source terminal agent keeps leveling up.

devin-desktop-v3-11-agent-window-ide.title: Devin Desktop v3.11 Just Replaced Your IDE — Agent Window, Side-by-Side Sessions, and Terminal in Every Tab
devin-desktop-v3-11-agent-window-ide.description: Devin Desktop v3.11.212 (October 23) ships a complete Agent Window overhaul matching the web app — drag-to-split sessions, per-session file trees, terminal tabs, cloud IDE button, app previews, Dev Containers support, and Electron 42 security fixes. The agent-native editor finally feels like a real IDE.

hermes-agent-beginners-guide-v0-22-5.title: Hermes Agent Just Got 10X More Usable — The Beginner's Guide to What Changed
hermes-agent-beginners-guide-v0-22-5.description: Hermes Agent v0.22.5 shipped 81 updates in 48 hours. Sign-in fixed, updates finally work, Windows UX polished, and you can now import Cursor configs. Here's what actually matters for daily use.

hermes-agent-v0-22-3-patch-620-fixes-wha.title: Hermes Agent Just Dropped 620 Fixes in One Patch — v0.22.3 Is the Release to Be On
hermes-agent-v0-22-3-patch-620-fixes-wha.description: Hermes Agent v0.22.3 (October 21) rolls up ~620 PRs since v0.22.2 — MCP live progress, refreshed CLI layout, OAuth for plugins, guided subagent picker, Telegram DM topics, Nemotron 3.5 Bolt, auto-prune on low disk, and the Microsoft Store build that finally ships automatically. The stable version of the Threshold Release just got sturdier.

hermes-agent-v0-22-5-patch-81-prs-stable.title: Hermes Agent v0.22.5 Just Landed — 81 Fixes, Sign-In Overhauled, and Windows Update Finally Works
hermes-agent-v0-22-5-patch-81-prs-stable.description: Hermes Agent v0.22.5 dropped October 22 with 81 PRs merged — plain device sign-in that actually works, Windows update unstuck after Python repin, pluggable delegation backends, plugin slash commands with pickers, and the Singularity backend moving to plugins. The quiet patch that fixes daily friction.

openclaw-2026-10-6-security-patch.title: OpenClaw Just Patched the eMudhra Certificate Compromise — Update Node Before You Start

what-developers-think-layerfs-vibe-codin.title: What Developers Actually Think About 'Vibe Coding' Infrastructure — From 200+ HN Comments on LayerFS

zed-v1-26-1-pre-pyrefly-dwarf-debugging.title: Zed Just Added Pyrefly, DWARF WASM Debugging, and Expandable Variable Hovers — v1.26.1-pre Is Here
zed-v1-26-1-pre-pyrefly-dwarf-debugging.description: Zed v1.26.1-pre (Oct 21) adds Pyrefly as optional Python language server, DWARF debugging for WebAssembly in JS debugger, expandable keyboard-accessible variable tree in debugger hovers, improved OpenCode compatibility, and Display P3 color space on macOS.

ampcode-security-certificate-authorities.title: AmpCode Just Removed Trust in Compromised Certificate Authorities — Update Your CLI Now
ampcode-security-certificate-authorities.description: AmpCode's October 22 security update removes trust in eMudhra (emSign) certificates. If your MCP servers or proxies use these CAs, you'll see 'untrusted certificate' errors. Here's what to do and why it matters for your agent's supply chain.

beware-openclaw-google-oauth-client-secr.title: Beware: OpenClaw Leaks Google OAuth Client Secrets to AI Models — Your GOCSPX Keys Are Visible in Plain Text
beware-openclaw-google-oauth-client-secr.description: OpenClaw's redaction system misses Google OAuth client secrets (GOCSPX-...). When agents read credential files, these secrets enter the model context and session transcripts unmasked. Here's how to check if you're affected and what to do.

claude-code-v2-1-308-310-stability-surge.title: Claude Code Just Dropped 3 Stability Releases in 3 Days — Your Agent Finally Stops Breaking
claude-code-v2-1-308-310-stability-surge.description: Claude Code v2.1.308, v2.1.309, and v2.1.310 (Oct 22-24) form a massive stability wave: sandbox fixes, hook reliability, compaction that doesn't lose your work, Windows Git Bash fixes, VS Code panel recovery, and cloud session enterprise controls. The 'it just works' release you've been waiting for.

goose-v1-56-automatic-thinking-resume-su.title: Goose Just Learned to Think Automatically, Resume Crashed Subagents, and Got a Real Windows Installer
goose-v1-56-automatic-thinking-resume-su.description: Goose v1.56.0 (Oct 23) adds automatic thinking level for models, resumes failed/cancelled delegate subagents, view-only subagent sessions in UI, concurrent subagent limits, Windows NSIS installer, IO Intelligence provider, and replaces PCTX with Boa JavaScript runtime.

kilocode-v7-8-17-security-patch-browser-.title: KiloCode Just Patched the eMudhra Certificate Compromise — Browser Links and MCP OAuth Now Locked Down

Plus session PR badges restored and Kilo Cloud provider added.

openclaw-2026-10-7-replay-safe-recovery.title: OpenClaw 2026.10.7: Your Sessions Finally Survive Crashes, Updates, and Gateway Restarts
openclaw-2026-10-7-replay-safe-recovery.description: OpenClaw 2026.10.7 (Oct 24) is the continuity release: replay-safe session recovery, safer update activation, database/worker continuity, backup durability, operator control survival, provider/plugin continuity, cross-platform upgrade convergence, plus Gemini 4 Argon. 70 PRs, zero breaking changes.

opencode-212k-stars-spacex-cursor-migrat.title: OpenCode Just Hit 212K Stars — Developers Are Fleeing Cursor for It
opencode-212k-stars-spacex-cursor-migrat.description: After SpaceX bought Cursor for $60B, 212K developers voted with their stars. OpenCode became the #1 open-source coding agent overnight. Here's why the migration isn't stopping.

opencode-v2-1-4-mcp-forms-background-com.title: OpenCode Just Made MCP Actually Usable — The v2.1.4 Release Developers Have Been Waiting For
opencode-v2-1-4-mcp-forms-background-com.description: OpenCode v2.1.4 (October 23) fixes the biggest MCP pain point: forms now appear instead of timing out. Plus background compaction, Bun 1.4.4 security fixes, faster code display, and voice model discovery. Here's what actually matters.

qwen-code-v0-26-managed-agent-desktop-lo.title: Qwen Code v0.26 Just Became a Full Multi-Agent Platform — Local, Remote, and Everything In Between
qwen-code-v0-26-managed-agent-desktop-lo.description: Qwen Code v0.26.0 (October 21) transforms the CLI into a multi-agent platform: managed agent sessions with durable state, desktop app v0.26, local and SSH workspace references, session-targeted skill refresh, and a read-only --check preflight. cline-desktop-v0-0-48-gpt6-support-claud.title: Cline Desktop v0.0.48 Just Fixed GPT-6 on OpenAI — And Brought Back Sonnet 5.5 as Default
cline-desktop-v0-0-48-gpt6-support-claud.description: Cline Desktop v0.0.48 (October 17) fixes GPT-6 model requests on OpenAI/Azure that were silently failing, restores Claude Sonnet 5.5 as the Cline provider default, and adds CommandCode + Reflection providers to the catalog. The desktop release that makes frontier models work.

cline-desktop-v0-0-49-changes-terminal-l.title: Cline Desktop Just Became a Full IDE — Changes Panel, File Tree, Terminal, and Local Models All Landed
cline-desktop-v0-0-49-changes-terminal-l.description: Cline Desktop v0.0.49 (October 26) transforms the app into a complete coding environment: new Changes button shows diffs per turn, project files panel with git status, integrated terminal (Ctrl+`), Local Models page for Ollama/LM Studio, configurable keybindings, and PR status in the header. The desktop agent that finally feels like an IDE.

cline-sdk-v0-2-0-session-reattachment-hu.title: Cline SDK Just Rewrote How Sessions Work — Reattachment, Hub Reliability, and Smarter Retries Land in v0.2.0
